'''Sigrid Doris Peyerimhoff''' (born 12 January 1937, in [[Rottweil]]) is a [[theoretical chemistry|theoretical chemist]] and Emeritus Professor at the Institute of Physical and Theoretical Chemistry, [[University of Bonn]], [[Germany]].{{Infobox scientist
| name = Sigrid D. Peyerimhoff
| workplaces = [[University of Gießen]],

==Education==
After completing her ''[[abitur]]'', Peyerimhoff studied physics at the [[University of Gießen]], completing her degree in 1961 and receiving her doctorate under supervision of Bernhard Kockel in 1963.<ref>{{Cite book|title=Zweihundert Jahre Entwicklung der Theoretischen Chemie im deutschsprachigen Raum|last=Jug|first=Karl|publisher=Springer-Verlag|year=2014|isbn=9783662433652|location=Berlin [Germany]|oclc=894508769}}</ref> After researching at the [[University of Chicago]], the [[University of Washington]], and [[Princeton University]], she returned to Germany and gained her [[habilitation]] at the University of Gießen in 1967. She became professor for theoretical chemistry at the [[University of Mainz]] in 1970, and at the [[University of Bonn]] in 1972.

== Quantum chemistry ==
Her contributions have been to the development of ''ab initio'' [[quantum chemistry|quantum chemical]] methods, in particular, [[multireference configuration interaction]], and to their application in many fields of physics and chemistry. Particular emphasis has been given to electronically [[excited state]]s, [[spectroscopy|molecular spectra]] and [[photochemistry]]. Many studies are on atmospheric molecules and ions, their lifetimes in excited states and decomposition due to radiative and non-radiative processes, and on stability and spectra of clusters.

Some of her students became well known for their contribution to quantum chemistry, including [[Bernd Engels]], [[Stefan Grimme]], [[Bernd A. Hess]], [[Christel Marian]], [[Matthias Ernzerhoff]] and [[Bernd M. Nestmann]].

==Awards and honors==
During her career, she received several awards and memberships:

* 1977 Medal of the [[International Academy of Quantum Molecular Science]] 
* 1988 [[Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz-Prize]] 
* 1994 [[Order of Merit of the Federal Republic of Germany|Cross of Merit of the Federal Republic of Germany]]
* 2007 [[Cothenius Medal]] of the [[Academy of Sciences Leopoldina]]<ref name="iaqms">[http://www.iaqms.org/members/peyerimhoff.php Sigrid Peyerimhoff] auf der Website der International Academy of Quantum Molecular Science.</ref>
* 2008 [[Order of Merit of the Federal Republic of Germany|Grand Cross of Merit of the Federal Republic of Germany]]<ref>[http://www.nrw.de/presse/emeritierte-forscherin-wird-fuer-lebenswerk-ausgezeichnet-4210/ ''Minister Prof. Dr. Andreas Pinkwart überreicht Bonner Professorin Sigrid Peyerimhoff das Große Verdienstkreuz''], Landesregierung Nordrhein-Westfalen, 29. Februar 2008, Retrieved 20 October 2010.</ref>
* 2011 Honorary doctor of the [[University of Ulm]]<ref>[http://www.academianet.de/alias/Aktuelles/Sigrid-Peyerimhoff-erhaelt-Ehrendoktorwuerde/1116852 ''Sigrid Peyerimhoff erhält Ehrendoktorwürde''], academianet.de, 3. August 2011.</ref>

She is also a member of the [[International Academy of Quantum Molecular Science]]

==Publications==
She is the author of over 400 original articles in various international journals<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.thch.uni-bonn.de/tc/index.php?section=publikationen&subsection=peyerimhoff|title=Publication list|website=uni-bonn.de|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070104112821/http://www.thch.uni-bonn.de/tc/index.php?section=publikationen&subsection=peyerimhoff|archive-date=4 January 2007}}</ref> and coauthor of ''Umweltstandards: Fakten und Bewertungsprobleme am Beispiel des Strahlenrisikos''. Her history of [[computational chemistry]] in Germany is of particular note.<ref>"[http://www.quantum-chemistry-history.com/Pey_ff_Dat/CompGerm/Pey_ff_CompGerm.htm The Development of Computational Chemistry in Germany]", ''Reviews in Computational Chemistry'', Volume 18, pg 257, 2002</ref> She edited ''Interactions in Molecules''.<ref>[http://www.wiley-vch.de/publish/en/books/ISBN3-527-27732-3/ Wiley page on ''Interactions in Molecules'']</ref>
